Outboard pod lift starting at 5 m plus the softer dy ramp (l.479): canoes 8.3 -> 8.6, about +0.05.
Pylon saddle and round crown (l.451): pylon 7.5 -> 8.0, about +0.05.
Lip-end liner lift plus baked rings (l.384-387): inlet 7.7 -> 8.0 and artefacts +0.2, about +0.05. Together with the panel tone, these give about +0.25-0.3.
